attchmntText: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited held an Investors and Analysts Conference Call on November 12, 2026, at 12:00 Noon. The discussion covered the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, of the Financial Year 2026-27. The audio recording of the conference call is available on the Company’s website at www.exicom.com. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46(2)(oa) of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited submitted an investors presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 04, 2026. Consolidated revenue was approximately Rs. 388 crore, representing a 38% year-over-year increase. Standalone revenue reached Rs. 277 crore, up 21.3% year-over-year. Consolidated EBITDA turned positive at Rs. 1.8 crore, compared to a loss of Rs. 32.7 crore in the previous year. Standalone EBITDA grew 69% year-over-year to Rs. 25.6 crore. The EV segment recorded its first quarter with over Rs. 100 crore in revenue. The Board approved the divestment of the Tritium business while retaining a perpetual license for TRI-FLEX technology outside the Americas. The order book and advance pipeline stood at Rs. 1,645 crore as of September 30, 2026.

voiceSummary: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 7, 2026, regarding its Postal Ballot Notice in Business Standard and Hind Janpath. Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company Limited is conducting an e-auction on December 9, 2026, for immovable secured assets of borrowers Sumit Bhatia, Kamal Kumari, and Santosh Kumari. The reserve price is Rs. 54,00,000. Black Rose Industries Limited filed un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Poonawalla Fincorp Limited announced a public auction of gold jewelry on November 12, 2026, in Moga, Punjab, to recover dues from borrowers Mohd Dilshad, Mandeep Singh, and Raj Kumar.
